title: Slice drop
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $k$ and a finite Boolean list $z$, decode $z$ into a pair of Boolean lists $(u,v)$. The slice-drop list is the pair encoding of $u$ and the list obtained from $v$ by deleting its first $	ext{polyLen}(a,k,|u|)$ entries.
caveat: The supplied context does not define the pair encoding, its decoder, or polyLen, so their precise conventions cannot be stated.
